title: MCP Server
description: Connect AI agents to this project over the Model Context Protocol. An agent gets the access of the API key it uses.
offForTeam: MCP is switched off for the team {team}.
offForProject: The team {team} has MCP on, but its reach does not cover this project.
askManager: Ask an owner or a manager of the team to open it:
keyHint: Create a personal key on the API keys page, then replace {apiKey} in the snippet.

notes.claudeDesktop: Claude Desktop reaches remote servers through the mcp-remote bridge. Needs Node.js.
notes.other: Any client that supports MCP over Streamable HTTP works. Point it at the endpoint and send an Authorization: Bearer {apiKey} header.
